package.name: @hermes/plugin-sdk
package.evidence: npm view @hermes/plugin-sdk -> 404 on the public registry

symbols.name: host
symbols.note: Gateway/state/composer doors. The only module-level value the plugin drives traffic through.

symbols.name: useValue
symbols.note: React binding for readonly atoms (re-exported useStore). RoutinesPage subscribes to host.state.

symbols.name: SIDEBAR_NAV_AREA
symbols.note: Sidebar nav row contribution area; paired with the ROUTES_AREA page.

symbols.name: PluginProfileRoute
symbols.note: connectionId / mode / profile / targetProfile descriptor; every routed call is keyed on it.

symbols.name: PluginContext
symbols.note: Scoped context handed to register(); this plugin only uses ctx.register.

symbols.name: HermesPlugin
symbols.note: The descriptor the plugin default-exports (loader contract).

symbols.name: profileRoutes
symbols.note: Inventories registered profile/connection routes; the resolver never falls back to the active gateway.

symbols.name: requestProfile
symbols.note: Registry-routed RPC (route, method, params, timeoutMs?, { spawnPriority? }). Carries every cron.manage call.

symbols.name: request
symbols.note: Active-gateway RPC (method, params?, timeoutMs?) — used only when no route resolves.

symbols.name: newChat
symbols.note: Opens the fresh guided-chat draft for a route. Only the one-argument form is used.

symbols.name: composer.setDraft
symbols.note: Fail-closed draft write for an addressed session; returns false when no mounted surface owns it.

symbols.name: composer.submit
symbols.note: Fail-closed submit for an addressed session; used only for the guided-chat auto-submit path.

symbols.name: state.profile
symbols.note: Readonly atom of the active gateway profile — the active-profile binding the page subscribes to.

symbols.name: state.connectionId
symbols.note: Readonly atom of the active connection id; profile + connectionId are matched as one identity.

symbols.name: PluginContribution
symbols.note: Structural stand-in for the ctx.register argument. Declared inside the shim, never imported by src (upstream defines it as Omit<Contribution, 'source' | 'id'> & { id: string }).

symbols.name: ReadableAtom
symbols.note: Minimal structural stand-in for the nanostores ReadableAtom that types host.state atoms. Declared inside the shim, never imported by src.
